$comment: Claude Code harness settings for the SDLC framework. Framework CONFIG (models, gates, paths) lives in sdlc-config.json — this file is only for harness behavior like hooks. Shipped/committed so every project gets ground-truth injection. verify-gate.sh runs on Stop and on writes to a phase manifest.json: it re-verifies the execution-guarantee contract (roster.json completeness + report integrity + no dangling failures + gate.passed honesty) in CODE, not prose — this is what makes the phase gate UN-BYPASSABLE by an agent that merely claims it passed. Its non-zero exit blocks the turn from ending / the manifest write from being trusted. The Stop hook takes no phase arg, so verify-gate.sh auto-detects the latest agent_state/phases/<N> dir. autonomous-continue.sh (Stop) blocks ending the turn while agent_state/autonomous/run.json says a /autonomous run is 'running', so the pipeline doesn't stall between sub-commands; it yields on awaiting_human/paused/complete/failed or when no progress is made. Hook paths use $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; new-project.sh and /autonomous Step 0 copy .claude/hooks into the project.
